# Add Machine wrapper for inner PVM lifecycle

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary

- Add high-level `Machine` class wrapping PVM inner machine ecallis (8-13) with type-safe lifecycle management
- Create → peek/poke/pages/invoke → expunge lifecycle enforced through the API
- `InvokeIo` typed wrapper for the 112-byte gas+registers I/O structure
- `InvokeOutcome` pairs exit reason with r8 and io reference for HOST loop handling
- Restructure SDK API docs by invocation context (common/refine/accumulate/authorize)

## New types

- `Machine` — create, peek, poke, pages, invoke, expunge
- `InvokeIo` — typed gas + register access (r0-r12)
- `InvokeOutcome` — exit reason + r8 + io reference
- `ExitReason` — Halt, Panic, Fault, Host, Oog
- `PageAccess` — Inaccessible, Read, ReadWrite
- `InvalidEntryPoint`, `OutOfBounds` — error enums
- `TestMachine` — AS-side test helper for configuring mock stubs

## Test plan

- [x] 20 unit tests covering all Machine methods, InvokeIo, InvokeOutcome
- [x] Happy paths and error paths (OOB, HUH, all exit reasons)
- [x] Edge cases (u64 max values, Fault with address, configured expunge result)
- [x] All 165 SDK tests pass
- [x] All example tests pass (all-ecalli, ecalli-test, authorizer, fibonacci)
- [x] Biome CI passes

Introduces TestMachine and test APIs that set configurable ecalli return values for refine machine operations, updates sdk-ecalli-mocks to expose those setters, adds Jest/TypeScript tests for InvokeIo and Machine behavior, and reorganizes the SDK API documentation into focused subpages.
